name: coreblow
description: CoreBlow — enterprise AI gateway and personal assistant runtime
author: Febrinanda and CoreBlow contributors

scripts.build:runtime: node scripts/tsdown-build.mjs && node scripts/runtime-postbuild.mjs && node scripts/build-stamp.mjs && pnpm build:plugin-sdk:dts && pnpm sdk:entry-dts
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.lint:all: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:circular && pnpm lint:unused-exports && pnpm lint:channel-boundaries && pnpm lint:no-raw-channel-fetch
scripts.test:all: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:contracts: COREBLOW_TEST_PROFILE=serial pnpm exec vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.contracts.config.ts
scripts.release:check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:all && pnpm test && pnpm lint:bundle-size
scripts.ci: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.ci:full: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:all && pnpm test:all
